title: Locomotive: the hero shrinks while its title holds on
note: Scrolling down, the hero does not slide away: its bottom edge rises (the box gets shorter, the video stays put inside) and the title rides up on that bottom edge until only a 300px band with the title is left, then the page carries on in white. The header stays on top in difference blend. In GSAP: a scrubbed ScrollTrigger on clip-path inset(0 0 X% 0) or height, with the title absolutely positioned at the bottom of the clipped box. Worth reusing: the hero gives way to the content but its title stays readable a while longer, a gentler handover than a parallax slide.
